fields.title: 📖 A little Sunnah is better than much Bidʿah
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“A little upon the Sunnah is better than much effort in a Bidʿah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The measure is not how much a person does, but whether his deed stands upon the **Sunnah**. A small deed on a sound basis is better than great exertion on an invented path.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Baṭṭah, al-Ibānah al-Kubrā, Muqaddimah al-Muʾallif, Bāb: Mā Umira bihi min at-Tamassuk bi-s-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah wa-l-Akhdh bihā, Athar Nr. 247, Juzʾ 1, S. 329–338.
